description: In a quantum information analysis of the Posner model, Halpern and Crosson showed that entanglement can change molecular binding rates, raising a binding probability from 33.6% to 100% in one example.
limitations: Assumes Fisher's premises hold. A theoretical example, not a measurement.

sources.quote: we show that entanglement can affect molecular-binding rates, boosting a binding probability from 33.6% to 100% in an example
